label: R34 ashfoot
brief: Inside a ranger shelter in the Stormwood settlement, one fixed view in four storm phases (top row calm, building; bottom row break, fading), with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether the room reads as a lived-in Stormwood shelter that belongs to the key art's world, and whether the storm outside reads, and differs, in each phase.
defects: the storm window is a glowing slab standing off the wall
the phases barely differ through the window
a pale untextured shard pokes through the roof apex
